newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Nov 15.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Nov 15.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Bunker prices were unchanged despite lower cargo levels. Majors said market was very thin ahead of the weekend. "There were hardly any sales as seller were holding out at around Thursday's quotes which were considered high by buyers," a major said. Traders said the softer cargo market seen late Friday will place pressure on bunker prices next week.
